Title: Enacts the Bicycle Traffic Safety Education Alternative act
Summary: Enacts the "Bicycle Traffic Safety Education Alternative act" under which a person charged with a noncriminal traffic violation arising from the operation of a bicycle or bicycle with electric assist may elect to view a bicycle traffic safety education video approved by the commissioner in lieu of payment of a fine.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to enacting the "Bicycle Traffic Safety Education Alternative act"
